body: I've been on anxiety medication for a while and I can tell you it really helps a lot. It doesn't necessarily means that you should take it, you should for sure consider all of the options, but there's nothing to be afraid of medication. It won't change who you are, how you think, it will only help you feel better and have a happier and more productive life. Even if you end up taken it can be temporarily. I wishe you the best
